meta.title: Master QCS of a vendor-masked company
gaps: Verify that the company has vendor masking enabled as a tenant setting.
Verify the masking behavior across multiple vendors or its removal when masking ends; the prepared state exposes only one vendor and one closed-event snapshot.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the company has vendor masking enabled as a tenant setting.; Verify the masking behavior across multiple vendors or its removal when masking ends; the prepared state exposes only one vendor and one closed-event snapshot.

steps.note: Open the existing prepared closed RFQ directly on its Master QCS, as required for prepared-state cases.
Assert that the comparison grid has the prepared event's single vendor column while allowing the masked label.
Verify that the vendor is displayed with a masked generic label rather than an identified company name.
Verify the available vendor is ranked first.
Verify the displayed RFQ price matches the prepared bid price.
Verify the displayed line amount and sum total are calculated correctly from the bid rate and quantity.
